column2: ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bilmuhtadīn
ʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhi ʾāyātunā qāla ʾasāṭīru l-ʾawwalīn
ʾinnā balawnāhum kamā balawnā ʾaṣḥāba l-jannati ʾidh ʾaqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣbiḥīn
Faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāʾifun min rabbika wahum nāʾimūn
ʾani ghdū ʿalā ḥarthikum ʾin kuntum ṣārimīn
ʾan lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum miskīn
Qāla ʾawsaṭuhum ʾalam ʾaqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūn
Qālū subḥāna rabbinā ʾinnā kunnā ẓālimīn
ʿasā rabbunā ʾan yubdilanā khayran minhā ʾinnā ʾilā rabbinā rāghibūn
Kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu lākhirati ʾakbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
ʾinna lilmuttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti n-naʿīm
ʾam lakum ʾaymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ʾilā yawmi l-qiyāmati ʾinna lakum lamā taḥkumūn
ʾam lahum shurakāʾu falyaʾtū bishurakāʾihim ʾin kānū ṣādiqīn
Yawma yukshafu ʿan sāqin wayudʿawna ʾilā s-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūn
Khāshiʿatan ʾabṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yudʿawna ʾilā s-sujūdi wahum sālimūn
Fadharni waman yukadhdhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūn
ʾam tasaluhum ʾajran fahum min maghramin muthqalūn
Faṣbir liḥukmi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti ʾidh nādā wahuwa makẓūm
Lawlā ʾan tadārakahu niʿmatun min rabbihi lanubidha bilʿarāʾi wahuwa madhmūm
Waʾin yakādu ladhīna kafarū layuzliqūnaka biʾabṣārihim lammā samiʿū dh-dhikra wayaqūlūna ʾinnahu lamajnūn
